name: InhalersWithCorticosteroidsProductFormsOnly
title: Inhalers with corticosteroids (Product forms only)
purpose:
(Clinical Focus: Used to identify all inhalation medications that include corticosteroids),(Data Element Scope: DRUG_CLASS_MEMBERS: PHARMACOLOGIC:),(Inclusion Criteria: Products for treatment of COPD and Asthma associated with the IN or PIN for 
Beclomethasone Dipropionate (PIN =1348),
Budesonide (IN =19831),
Ciclesonide (IN = 274964),
Fluticasone Furoate (PIN =705022),
Fluticasone Propionate (PIN = 50121).
Mometasone (IN =108118),
Mometasone Furoate (PIN =30145)),(Exclusion Criteria: TTY other than SBD, SCD, GPCK, BPCK)
